senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (वेपयति)
To throw.

f. (-पा)
Lightning.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Matured, ripened.
2 Fulfilled, come to pass, as the consequence of former actions.
E.
वि, and पच to cook, क्त्रि aff., and मप् augment.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Opposed or adverse to, contrary, inimical.
m. (-क्षः)
1 An enemy, an adversary.
2 A disputant, an opponent.
3 Exception, (in grammar, &c.)
4 (In logic,) An argument or syllogism in which the proposition to be maintained is wanting.
E.
वि implying opposite, contrary, and पक्ष part or side.

ind.
Hostilely, inimically.
E.
विपक्ष, and तसि aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Hostility, enmity, opposition.
2 Controversy, contradiction in argument.
E.
तल् added to विपक्ष; also with त्व विपक्षत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Indifferent, impartial.
E.
वि priv., पक्षपात an adherent.

f. (-का)
A lute.
E.
कन् fem. form, added to the next.

f. (-ञ्ची)
1 A lute.
2 Play, sport, pastime.
E.
वि before पचि to extend, (causal form,) to diffuse sounds, aff. अच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.

m. (-णः)
Sale, contract of sale.
E.
वि before पण to be of price, aff. घञ् or घ; also with ल्युट्, विपणन n. (-नं.)

mf. (-णिः-णी)
1 A place where things are sold, a shop, a stall.
2 A fair, a market, a market place.
3 The street of a market.
4 An article or commodity for sale.
E.
वि before पण to transact business, aff. इक्, and fem. aff. ङीष्.

m. (-णी)
A dealer, a trafficker, a shop-keeper or merchant.
E.
विपण sale, इनि aff.

n. (-लं)
Time of calamity or misfortune, adversity.
E.
विपट्, and काल time.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Adversity, calamity, misfortune.
2 Pain, agony.
3 Death, dying.
E.
वि implying reverse, पत् to go, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Unfortunate.
E.
विपत्ति, and युक्त joined.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Properous, happy.
E.
विपत्ति, and रहित free from.

m. (-रः)
Heavy calamity.
E.
विपत्, and सागर ocean.

mn. (-थः-थं)
A bad road.
E.
वि depreciative prefix, and पथ for पथिन् a road.

f. (-पत् or पद्)
Calamity, adversity, misfortune.
E.
वि before पद to go, क्विप् aff.; also with टाप् added, विपदा.

f. (-दा)
Adversity.
E.
see the last.

m. (-रः)
Extrication from misfortune.
E.
विपत्, and उद्धार lifting up; also विपटुद्धरणं, &c.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Overtaken by or involved in calamity.
E.
विपट्, and ग्रस्त seized.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Unhappy, unfortunate.
E.
विपट्, and युक्त joined.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Prosperous.
E.
विपट्, and रहित left by.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Unfortunate, declined, fallen into adversity or misfortune.
2 Lost, destroyed, annihilated.
3 Dead, defunct.
m. (-न्नः)
A snake.
E.
वि implying reverse, and पद to go, aff. क्त; also with कन् added विपन्नक.

m. (-मः)
Change of state or form.
E.
वि and परि before णम to bow, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Undergoing or producing change of state or form.
E.
वि and परि before णम to bow, घिनुण् aff.

n. (-नं)
Turning back or away from.
E.
वि, and परिवर्त्तन turning round.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Turned back or away from, reverted, averted.
E.
वि and परि before वृत to turn, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reverse, inverse, opposite, contrary.
f. (-ता)
A lewd woman, a dishonest wife.
E.
वि and परि implying contrariety or reverse, before इत gone.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Perverse, contradictory, acting contrary to another's wishes.
E.
विपरीत, and कारिन् who does; also विपरीतकर, विपरीतकर्त्तृ, &c.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Going backwards or reversely.
f. (-तिः)
Inverse or reverse motion.
E.
विपरीत, and गति going.

f. (-ता)
Contrariety, reverse or opposite state or condition.
E.
विपरीत, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विपरीतत्वं.

m. (-कः)
The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
वि separate, पर्ण a leaf, and कन् added.

m. (-यः)
1 Contrariety, opposition.
2 Reverse in general, and thence applied to that of which reverse is predicated, as misery, calamity, (the reverse of fortune); error, misapprehension, (the reverse of reason or truth); inverted order or succession, (the reverse of that which is usual or prescribed,) &c.
3 Destruction, annihilation.
4 Perverseness of disposition.
5 Change of purpose or conduct.
6 Enmity, hostility.
E.
वि and परि implying reverse, and इ to go, aff. अच्; also with घञ् aff. विपर्य्याय m. (-यः)

m. (-यः)
Contrariety, &c.; see विपर्य्यय.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Opposite, contrary, reverse.
2 Conceived to be real (what is not so).
E.
वि and परि before अस to be, or to throw, क्त aff.

m. (-सः)
1 Contrariety, opposition.
2 Reverse.
3 Investing imaginary things with real attributes, imagining what is unreal or false to be real or true.
E.
वि and परि before अस to be, aff. घञ्.

n. (-लं)
A moment, an instant, either a Pala or second, or (1/6)th of it; a simple breathing or (1/16)th of the latter.
E.
वि, and पल a second.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Unattended, unguarded.
E.
वि priv., पाल a keeper.

n. (-नं)
Flying, running away.
E.
वि, and पलायन the same.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Put to flight, run away.
E.
वि before पलायित the same.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be cleansed or purified.
E.
वि before पूञ् to purify, aff. क्यप्.

m. (-श्चित्)
A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman, a teacher.
E.
वि before चि to collect, affs. क्विप् and तुक्, form irr.

n. (-श्यं)
Knowledge.
E.
वि variously, पश्य seeing.

m. (-श्यी)
A Bauddha saint, the first of the seven principal Buddhas.
E.
विपश्य, and इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Cooking, dressing.
2 Ripening, maturing.
3 Flavour, taste..
4 Unexpected or improbable result.
5 Poverty, distress.
6 Change of form or state.
7 The consequences of actions, either in this or in a former birth; the operation of time in maturing their results.
8 Assimilation of food, its conversion into a state differing from its original one, digestion.
E.
वि before पच to ripen, aff. घञ्.

m. (-ठः)
An arrow.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Pale, pallid, white.
E.
वि, and पाण्डुर pale.

n. (-नं)
Destroying, killing.
E.
वि before पद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be killed, fit or proper to be destroyed.
E.
वि before पद to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also विपाद्य and विपादयितव्य.

f. (-का)
1 A kibe, a sore or blister on the foot.
2 A riddle, an enigma.
E.
वि before पद to go, aff. ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Killed, destroyed.
E.
वि before पद to go, causal v., क्त aff.

f. (-पाट्)
The Vipāś or Vipāśā river.
E.
see the next.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Unnoosed, unfettered, freed from a noose or tie.
f. (-शा)
1 The Vipāśā or the Beyāh river in the Pañjāb.
E.
वि privative, and पाश् or पाशा a noose, from पश to bind, causal form, with अच् and टाप् or क्विप् aff.; hence also विपाश्; the name applies to the river as having destroyed the cord which the Muni VAŚIṢṬHA had tied round his neck, when about to hang himself through grief for the death of his sons slain by VIŚVĀMITRA.

n. (-नं)
A wood, a forest.
E.
वेप to shake, Uṇādi aff. इनन्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Large, great.
2 Broad.
3 Deep, profound.
m. (-लः)
1 The mountain Meru, or rather the western branch of it.
2 The Himālaya mountain.
3 A respectable man.
f. (-ला)
1 The earth.
2 A form of the Āryā metre in which the line is irregularly divided by the Cœsura or pause: three species of this form are reckoned; the Ādivipulā with the pause in the first line, Antyavipulā in the second, and Ubhayavipulā in both lines.
E.
वि before पुल to be large or lofty, aff. क.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Free from horripilation.
E.
वि privative, and पुलक erection of the hair of the body.

f. (-ता)
Magnitude, extent.
E.
विपुल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व विपुलत्वं.

m. (-सः)
The sugar-cane.
E.
विपुल much, and रस juice.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Large-eyed.
E.
विपुल, and ईक्षण sight.

m. (-यः)
The Munja grass, (Saccharum Munja.)
E.
वि before पुञ् to cleanse, aff. क्यप्; that which is to be cleaned before making into ropes, &c.

m. (-प्रः)
1 A Brahman.
2 (In prosody,) A foot of four short syllables.
E.
वि before प्रा Sautra root, to fill or complete, (the essential observances,) and क aff.; or वप to shave, Uṇādi aff. रन्, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.

m. (-रः)
1 Injury, contumely, abuse.
2 Wickedness.
3 Opposition, counteraction.
4 Retaliation.
E.
वि and प्र depreciative prefixes, and कार making.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Opposed to, treating with contempt.
2 Retaliating.
E.
वि and प्र before कृ to do, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Reviled, abused, treated with contempt or contumely.
2 Opposed, counteracted.
3 Injured, offended.
4 Retaliated, requited.
E.
वि and प्र before कृत made; made little or nothing of.

f. (-तिः)
1 Abuse, injury, contumely.
2 Retaliation, retort.
E.
वि and प्र implying depreciation or mutuality, and कृति action.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Remote, distant.
E.
वि and प्र before कृष to attract, aff. क्त; also with कन् added, विप्रकृष्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं).

m. (-रः)
1 Contradiction, counteraction, opposition.
2 Reverse.
3 Retaliation.
E.
वि and प्रति before कृ to do, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Opposed, counteracted.
2 Requited.
E.
वि and प्रति before कृ to do, क्त aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Perplexity, confusion.
2 Various acquirement.
3 Mutual connexion with or relation to.
4 Conversancy.
5 Contradiction, difference, discrepancy.
6 Contest, dispute.
7 Opposition of interests.
E.
वि privative, or implying variety, and प्रतिपत्ति knowledge.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 To be opposed, contradicted, contested.
2 To be acquired.
E.
प्रति before पद to go, यत् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being disputed or contested.
2 Being in course of acquirement.
E.
वि and प्रति before पद to go, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Bewildered, perplexed, confused, uncertain.
2 Conversant or acquainted with in various ways, severally or mutually.
3 Connected with.
4 Contested, disputed.
5 Contradicted.
6 Opposed, (as interests.)
E.
वि, and प्रतिपन्न ascertained, &c.

m. (-रः)
Repentance: see विप्रतीसार.

m. (-रः)
1 Repentance.
2 Evil, wickedness, evil action.
3 Hate, enmity.
4 Rage, wrath.
E.
वि implying reverse, प्रति to or towards, सार going, conduct; the इ of प्रति optionally long; otherwise विप्रतिसार.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Contradicted, opposed.
2 Prohibited, forbidden.
E.
वि, and प्रति implying opposition, and सिद्ध proved, perfected.

m. (-हः)
Dried fruit or roots, &c.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Spoiled, vitiated, defiled.
2 Bad, corrupt.
E.
वि and प्र before टुष्ट the same.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Bad, vicious, sensual, corrupt.
E.
विप्रटुष्ट, and भाव disposition or nature.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
To be liberated or freed from.
E.
वि and प्र before मुच् to loose, यत् aff.

n. (-णं)
Flight, retreat.
E.
वि and प्र before या to go, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Separated, disjoined, sundered, away or absent from.
E.
वि implying separation, प्रयुक्त joined.

m. (-गः)
1 Separation, absence, especially the separation of lovers.
2 Disunion, disjunction.
3 Quarrel, disagreement.
4 Deserving.
E.
वि before प्रयोग union, contiguity.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
1 Tricked, cheated, deceived.
2 Disappointed.
f. (-ब्धी)
A mistress whose lover is not true to his appointment.
E.
वि and प्र before लब्ध gained.

m. (-म्भः)
1 Tricking, deceiving, disappointing, deceiving by a false affirmation or by not keeping a promise.
2 Separation, especially of lovers.
3 Disunion, disjunction.
4 Quarrel, disagreement.
E.
वि and प्र implying reverse, लभि to get or gain, aff. घञ्.

m. (-पः)
1 Quarrel, wrangling, mutual contradiction.
2 Idle or unmeaning discourse, nonsense.
E.
वि and प्र implying contradiction or reciprocity, and लाप talk.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Rapacious, exacting, avaricious.
E.
वि and प्र before लुपि to cut off, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-सः)
Residence in a foreign country.
E.
वि and प्र implying separation, वस to abide, and घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Residence abroad.
2 Banishment.
E.
वि and प्र before वस to dwell, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

f. (-का)
A female fortune-teller.
E.
वि variously, पृच्छ to ask, aff. इञ्, with नङ् augment, and ठन् added.

ind.
As, like as, one with, a Brahman.
E.
विप्र, and साति aff.

n. (-स्वं)
The property of a Brahman.
E.
विप्र, and स्व own.

m. (-दः)
Abuse of a Brahman.
E.
विप्र, and अपवाद reviling.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Disliked, unbeloved, disagreeable.
n. (-यं)
Offence, transgression.
E.
वि privative, and प्रिय fond of.

f. (-प्रुट)
1 A drop of water, &c.
2 A spot, a mark, a dot.
E.
वि privative, प्रुष to burn, aff. क्विप्; also विप्लुष्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Absent, away from.
2 Banished.
E.
वि and प्र before वस to dwell, aff. क्त, the semivowel changed to उ.

f. (-का)
A woman whose husband or lover is absent.
E.
विप्रोषित absent, भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् aff.

ind.
Having been absent, returning, coming home.
E.
वि, and प्र before वस to dwell, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 Tumult, confusion, trouble.
2 Evil, calamity.
3 Rapine, extortion.
4 Sin, wickedness.
5 Predatory or irregular warfare.
6 Affray, scuffle.
7 Terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures.
8 Confusion, perplexity, (of thought or speech.)
E.
वि before प्लु to go, aff. अप्.

m. (-वः)
1 Deluging, inundating.
2 Devastating.
3 Causing tumult or public disturbance.
4 A horse's canter or gallop.
E.
वि, and प्लु to go, aff. घञ्.

ind.
1 Having cast away, defiled, contaminated.
2 Having taught at improper seasons.
3 Having caused to be deluged, devastated, &c.
E.
वि before प्लु to go, causal v., ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Depraved, wicked, addicted to evil practices, as gaming, whoring, &c.
2 Committing any crime.
3 Contrary, adverse, averse.
4 Inundated, immersed.
5 Devastated, ravaged.
E.
वि before प्लु to go, aff. क्त.

f. (-प्लुट)
1 A drop of any fluid.
2 A spot, a dot.
E.
वि before प्लुष to burn, aff. क्विप्; also विप्लुष्.

f. (-प्सा)
Repetition, succession: see वीप्सा.

f. (-प्सा)
Several or successive order, the arrangement of things or properties each by each, or in succession, as वृक्षं वृक्षं सिञ्चति he waters tree after tree.
E.
वि before अप to go, or get, desiderative form, अच् aff.
